name: Easy Markdown Review
description: Review Markdown like a Word doc in Azure DevOps: comment on rendered prose in pull requests, render Mermaid diagrams, see what changed, and browse every doc. Git stays the source of truth.

contributions.description: Tab on the pull request details page that renders Markdown files with a Word-doc-style review experience.
Top-level Documents hub group, parallel to Azure Repos. Hosts the repo-scoped Markdown documents browser with its own in-hub repo selector, so it doesn't inherit (or duplicate) the Repos repo picker.

Full-page Markdown documents browser + reader with inline comments. Direct nav shows the repo-scoped file view (with an in-hub repo selector); a bookmarked / shared deep-link URL opens a specific file + repo directly.
